mapping_method: Transclusion of the file on exactly this arcika container page, read from the pinned page inventory, with the container key derived from the page title's own dotted coordinate and required to resolve to a held Passage. Scope is the container the source itself chose; nothing was narrowed.

payload.why_container_and_not_verse: The source places these files on the arcika CONTAINER page, not on any verse. They are gana performances of 82s over a container holding many verses, and no source states a boundary inside any of them. Attaching one to a verse would be the prohibited case.

recension_evidence: The transcluding page is under सामवेदः/कौथुमीया/ (Kauthuma). The recording states no recension of its own.
